customrecordtype.description: One row per rep: whether the rep's browser phone can receive calls right now. Written only by the token RESTlet's phoneHeartbeat action (the softphone sends it on every registration change, on token refresh and every 5 minutes). Read by the Setup Wizard (Health and Inbound calls pages). Hidden from admin UI via allowuiaccess=F.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Employee
customrecordcustomfield.description: Rep whose browser phone this row describes. Set from the session (runtime.getCurrentUser), never from the request body.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Last Seen
customrecordcustomfield.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last heartbeat write. The Setup Wizard treats a phone as offline when this is older than 12 minutes.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Can Receive Calls
customrecordcustomfield.description: True when the phone is registered with Twilio and its token grants incoming calls.

customrecordcustomfield.label: State
customrecordcustomfield.description: Twilio device state: registered, unregistered, registering or offline (page closed).

customrecordcustomfield.label: Incoming Granted
customrecordcustomfield.description: True when the phone's access token grants incoming calls (config: inbound enabled).

customrecordcustomfield.label: Client
customrecordcustomfield.description: Short browser label, e.g. "Chrome 130 on macOS" (80 characters max).

customrecordcustomfield.label: Last Change
customrecordcustomfield.description: ISO 8601 UTC time when Can Receive Calls last changed value (or the row was created).
